title: Midday DCA run classification block (12:30 PM ET live execution)
description: The run_classification object embedded in every MIDDAY run_state artifact. The midday stream is a single 12:30 PM ET live Robinhood execution (run_type='midday_dca_live', trades=true) on account 562057042. It uses the afternoon 0x-to-5x sizing ladder and the same $3 base. It is INDEPENDENT of the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes ce16ba6b): stream='midday' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false always, so afternoon slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never treats a midday artifact as afternoon scheduled evidence. Midday fills count only as prior-allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard, and morning/manual buys count only as prior-allocation context for the midday top-up guard. Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Origin of the midday run. 'scheduled' is the 12:30 PM ET live execution; everything else is 'manual'.

run_type.description: 'midday_dca_live' for the 12:30 PM ET live execution. Deliberately never the afternoon 'scheduled_live_test' or any morning run_type.

stream.description: Stream marker. Always 'midday' so this artifact is never confused with the morning or afternoon stream.

trades.description: Always true: the midday stream is a live Robinhood execution.

manual_run.description: true for manual midday runs, false for scheduled midday runs. Must agree with run_origin.

cron_id.description: Midday task id: 'a6239dae' for the 12:30 PM ET live execution. Distinct from the morning tasks and the afternoon live task '10ce362c'.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Always null: the midday task supersedes nothing.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time, HH:MM. '12:30' for scheduled runs; null for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted midday window in ET, HH:MM.

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted midday window in ET, HH:MM.

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Contract version tag: 'midday-live-v1' for the live execution.

valid_afternoon_evidence.description: Always false. A midday artifact is NEVER valid afternoon scheduled-live evidence; it counts only as prior-allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard.

afternoon_live_cron_id.description: The afternoon live task id ('10ce362c') recorded for cross-reference only.

allOf.comment: Scheduled live execution: pinned window and run_id pattern.
Manual runs never use a scheduled run_id and are always manual_run=true.
